sources.name: TRT Haber
sources.notes: Official RSS directory confirmed. Website terms restrict reuse; written permission is required before collection or publication.

sources.name: Habertürk
sources.notes: Official RSS directory confirmed. Terms restrict automated bulk collection and reuse without written permission.

sources.name: T.C. Dışişleri Bakanlığı
sources.notes: Official RSS landing page confirmed; direct feed endpoints and republication conditions require confirmation.

sources.name: T.C. Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı
sources.notes: Official RSS directory exists, but site terms restrict copying, publishing and translation without permission. Do not ingest until written permission is obtained.

sources.name: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Açık Veri
sources.notes: License applies only to datasets explicitly published under the platform license, not general ministry news, images or third-party material. Review each dataset and attribution requirements before use; not a news feed.

sources.name: Anadolu Ajansı
sources.notes: Excluded from free-source assumptions. Reassess only after a subscription contract and cost are explicitly approved.

sources.name: Press Haber Ajansı (PHA)
sources.notes: Published terms permit free website/app republication with attribution. Collects the publisher's openly available lifestyle-sector RSS feeds (fashion/textiles, cosmetics/personal care, health, sports, food/beverage, retail, tourism, culture/arts); feed items are deduplicated across sectors by GUID. GUID is used only for deduplication, never as an article URL.

sources.name: Basin Bültenleri
sources.notes: Publisher page and FAQ state that news sites, newspapers and magazines may use official company bulletins free of charge, republish as-is with source attribution, and use press images supplied in bulletins. Collects the general feed plus the publisher's health, retail and tourism category feeds; duplicate items are deduplicated by GUID. Only recent, non-sensitive lifestyle items are imported.
